items.title: Help me to remember You
items.cue: What the Prophet ﷺ told Mu'adh never to leave after a prayer
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 1522: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/2039

when: At the end of every prayer
usage.evidence: The Prophet ﷺ took Mu'adh by the hand, told him twice that he loved him, and said: never leave saying this at the end of every prayer (Abu Dawud 1522).

items.title: You are Peace
items.cue: "O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace…"
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma antas-salaamu waminkas-salaam, tabaarakta yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikraam
items.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 591: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1275

provenance.note: The printed Abd al-Baqi text on Shamela has يا ذا الجلال; hadith-api has ذا الجلال without يا. We follow the printed edition.

when: After the prayer, following the three requests for forgiveness

items.title: Asking forgiveness, three times
items.cue: The first words once the prayer ends

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 591: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1275

usage.evidence: Thawban reports that when the Prophet ﷺ finished his prayer he asked forgiveness three times. Al-Awza'i, asked how, said: you say astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah (Muslim 591).

items.title: We worship none but Him
items.cue: What Ibn al-Zubayr said after each prayer and traced to the Prophet ﷺ
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ، وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
items.transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer, laa hawla walaa quwwata illaa billaah, laa ilaha illallaah, walaa na'budu illaa iyyaah, lahun-ni'matu walahul-fadl, walahuth-thanaa'ul-hasan, laa ilaha illallaahu mukhliseena lahud-deena walaw karihal-kaafiroon
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. There is no power and no strength except through Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is the blessing, His the bounty, and His the beautiful praise. There is no god but Allah; we are sincere to Him in religion, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 594: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1284

when: After each prayer, once the salam is said
usage.evidence: Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr said this after every prayer when he gave the salam, and said the Prophet ﷺ used to declare these words after every prayer (Muslim 594).

items.title: None can withhold what You give
items.cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said after every obligatory prayer, as al-Mughirah wrote to Mu'awiyah
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer, allaahumma laa maani'a limaa a'tayt, walaa mu'tiya limaa mana't, walaa yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the fortune of the fortunate is of no avail to him against You.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 844: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/1385

items.title: Refuge from cowardice and a feeble old age
items.cue: The refuge Sa'd taught his sons as the Prophet ﷺ said it after prayer
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-jubn, wa'a'oodhu bika an uradda ilaa ardhalil-'umur, wa'a'oodhu bika min fitnatid-dunyaa, wa'a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabr
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from cowardice. I seek refuge with You from being returned to the most feeble age. I seek refuge with You from the trials of this world. And I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 2822: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/4472

usage.evidence: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas taught his sons these words as a teacher teaches children to write, saying the Prophet ﷺ sought refuge with them after the prayer (al-Bukhari 2822).

items.title: Completing the hundred
items.cue: The words that complete the hundred after the glorification
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 597: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1293

when: After the thirty-three of each, to make a hundred
usage.evidence: Whoever glorifies, praises and magnifies Allah thirty-three times each after every prayer, ninety-nine in all, and completes the hundred with these words, his sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea (Muslim 597).
